runtimeChanges: src/boss-models.js load import/call only; independently added modelTimings preserved

verifiedCauseAndFix.cause: Babylon glTF default useMaxMorphTargetInfluencers unfreezes a manager, creating its packed morph texture, then changes numMaxInfluencers, which synchronizes and creates the identical texture again.
verifiedCauseAndFix.fix: For this boss load only, public module LoadAssetContainerAsync receives gltf.onMeshLoaded. At this synchronous callback targets exist and the manager is still frozen. Set the exact same default final optimizeInfluencers/max slots before the first unfreeze. Use public fields only, with the same attribute and texture-array-layer eligibility as the loader.
verifiedCauseAndFix.interpretation: Removed duplicate CPU packing and texture-array input payload. This is not a measured GPU-time reduction or a measured VRAM saving.

lifecycleFindings.finding: All large geometry vertex/index creation and the witch morph texture-array creation occur before the loader resolves. Hidden material isReady is not what triggers those already-created uploads.

lifecycleFindings.finding: Independent bear/goblin skeleton clones create their small own matrix texture at instantiate; Elena and Mourning adopt the resident container and have no SDK model clone or geometry/morph reupload. These independent skeleton resources are required for independent poses.

lifecycleFindings.classification: verified SDK CPU events plus explicit GPU limitation
lifecycleFindings.finding: No new large geometry or morph creation was observed. Bone matrices update on the first draw and on subsequent frames with the same normal policy: 2,432 to 16,448 input bytes per actor per frame in these fixtures. First non-Elena warning visibility updates its 1,560-byte position buffer. Removing these updates would change animation/ground conformity, so they were preserved.

optionalS23DiagnosticProposalForRoot.status: proposal only; existing diagnostics UI was not changed by this agent
optionalS23DiagnosticProposalForRoot.trigger: Only while the existing boss diagnostic records loading/preparation and the first few visible frames; restore wrappers when recording ends or the scene disposes.
measure: Per-engine CPU submission-call count, exact typed-array inputBytes, CPU elapsed call time, stage and maximum call time
Separate regular per-frame bone matrix updateRawTexture calls from new geometry/morph/image creation
For non-typed image sources record unknown payload bytes and dimensions instead of inventing compressed or VRAM bytes
candidateEndpoints: recordVertexArrayObject as a separate first-bind event
optionalS23DiagnosticProposalForRoot.avoidDoubleCounting: Count leaf upload endpoints or suppress nested create-to-update calls. Do not add both createRawTexture2DArray and its internal update as two uploads.
optionalS23DiagnosticProposalForRoot.overheadBound: Keep scalar counters and a short bounded stage histogram. No payload copies, hashes, stack traces, per-event unbounded arrays, readbacks, hidden draws, GPU fences or forced finish.
optionalS23DiagnosticProposalForRoot.labels: CPU upload API call ms and submitted input bytes, never GPU elapsed ms. A long CPU call can include synchronous driver overhead but does not measure GPU execution. Correlate with the existing frame spike timeline without declaring causal GPU time.

preserved: No hidden draw, readPixels, fence, finish or new render target
No global loader observer, engine prototype patch or dependency edit
limitations: Actual Node execution uses Babylon NullEngine. Texture arrays use an inert raw texture shim; actual model images/KTX are omitted.
Node native call times in the baseline probe are not device GPU measurements or a useful mobile FPS estimate.

The optimized hook belongs to the repository's existing default max-influencer=true boss loading contract. Independently configured pin=false loaders remain unchanged. A new external global observer mutating the boss loader policy after activation is outside this contract and is absent from the repository.
